request_payload.title: A molecular genetics view on Mucopolysaccharidosis Type II.

mentions.sentence: MPS II symptoms are caused by mutations in the lysosomal iduronate-2-sulfatase (IDS) gene.

candidates.label: IDS-related disorders (mucopolysaccharidosis type II, Hunter syndrome)
candidates.summary: X-linked deficiency of iduronate-2-sulfatase makes heparan and dermatan sulfate build up; the neuronopathic form also causes progressive cognitive decline.

candidates.label: IDUA-related disorders (mucopolysaccharidosis type I: Hurler, Hurler-Scheie, Scheie)
candidates.summary: Deficiency of alpha-L-iduronidase makes dermatan and heparan sulfate build up in many organs: coarse facial features, skeletal disease, heart and airway problem

candidates.label: GAA-related disorders (Pompe disease)
synonyms: GSD due to acid maltase deficiency, infantile onset
candidates.summary: Deficiency of acid alpha-glucosidase makes glycogen build up inside lysosomes of muscle cells, causing muscle weakness and breathing problems; the infantile for

candidates.label: KCNQ2-related disorders
synonyms: benign neonatal seizures caused by mutation in KCNQ2
candidates.summary: Gene-defined umbrella for conditions caused by variants in KCNQ2 (7 curated clinical entities in OMIM/Orphanet).

candidates.label: KCNT1-related disorders
synonyms: epilepsy of infancy with migrating focal seizures

autosomal dominant nocturnal frontal lobe epilepsy type 5
candidates.summary: Gene-defined umbrella for conditions caused by variants in KCNT1 (4 curated clinical entities in OMIM/Orphanet).

candidates.label: GBA1-related disorders (Gaucher disease)

candidates.label: CACNA1A-related disorders
candidates.summary: Gene-defined umbrella for conditions caused by variants in CACNA1A (8 curated clinical entities in OMIM/Orphanet).

candidates.label: ARSA-related disorders (metachromatic leukodystrophy)
candidates.summary: Deficiency of arylsulfatase A makes sulfatides build up and destroys myelin in the brain and nerves, causing loss of motor and cognitive skills.

candidates.label: BRAF-related RASopathies (cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome)
synonyms: cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome caused by mutation in BRAF
candidates.summary: Germline BRAF changes mostly cause cardiofaciocutaneous (CFC) syndrome: heart defects, skin and hair changes and developmental delay; some cause Noonan syndrome

candidates.label: CBL-related disorder
synonyms: Noonan syndrome-like disorder with or without juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia
Noonan syndrome-like disorder with juvenile myelomonocytic leukaemia
Noonan syndrome-like disorder with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia
candidates.summary: Germline CBL changes cause a Noonan syndrome-like disorder with a predisposition to juvenile myelomonocytic leukaemia.

mentions.sentence: The mutations cause a loss of enzymatic performance and result in the accumulation of glycosaminoglycans (GAGs), heparan sulfate and dermatan sulfate, which are no longer degradable.
